messages.subject: Introductory workshop in October, registration closes 22 Sept 2023
parts:
Summer (in northern hemisphere) holidays have (likely) drawn to a close 🌴, time to focus again upon the business of distance sampling.  The workshop takes place 09-20 October. However, registration closes in two weeks: 22 September.

Come along and join the nearly 200 ecologists and managers who have attended this workshop in the past four years. Details regarding the workshop and the registration process can be found on this page on our workshop website:

https://workshops.distancesampling.org/intro-oct-2023.html

If you have questions, or want to chat about workshop content, feel free to contact me by email. But don't wait too long as registration closes in two weeks.


Eric Rexstad

Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling

University of St Andrews
